description: Net worth history + account balances. Numbers to reason with — to display, use net_worth_trend.

endDate.description: Range end, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

groupBy.description: Granularity of the returned series. Each point carries that period's CLOSING balance. 'auto' picks a readable granularity for the span; set it explicitly to compare periods against each other — 'year' over a two-year range gives one point per year, 'month' gives one per month.

period.description: How far back the trend goes. Ignored when startDate/endDate are given.

startDate.description: Range start, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to a year before endDate.

summary.description: Omit the `points` series and return only the headline figures and accounts. Use this when you want the numbers to comment on rather than to chart — it is a fraction of the size of a full result.

name: get_net_worth
